objective: Audit surplus-dominating coalescent ancestors across different odd-count layers, the strict-valley suffix reduction, and endpoint injectivity for odd gaps in {1,2}, without promoting a finite cutoff to H72.

quantifiers: all finite binary words for the symbolic surplus-dominance and strict-valley proofs
all coefficient-safe words with 1<=Q<=17 and every admissible length
all coefficient-safe ancestors with Q_b<=17 reaching each audited canonical endpoint
all same-Q shorter arbitrary target words needed for the valley audit through Q=17
all odd-gap words with exponents in {1,2} through Q=17
exact_scope.completeness: The finite frontier is exhaustive only under Q_b<=17 and Q_d<=17. P86-P88 use separate exact proofs; no all-depth cutoff theorem is assumed.

arithmetic.floating_point_role: none in generator or verifier acceptance decisions

verifier_reconstructs: safe words, affine corrections, canonical source and endpoint representatives
same-Q, lower-or-equal-Q, and cutoff-Q surplus dominance
strict-valley suffix certificates from arbitrary shorter targets
the {1,2}-gap backward decoder and endpoint injectivity
all theorem examples and mandatory adversarial residues

stop_conditions: Stop and preserve the least mismatch if generator and verifier disagree.
Do not extrapolate Q<=17 survivor counts to unbounded Q.
Do not call an arbitrary coalescent target safe before extracting and checking its strict-valley suffix.
Keep H72 open unless an all-depth positive-source exclusion is proved.
Enter the proof-claim emergency protocol before any change to proves_collatz.
interpretation_boundary: P86 is a least-source theorem, not a proof that a dominating ancestor always exists.
P87 requires separate positivity, literal coalescence, and V<S checks.
Q<=17 survivor and Pareto counts are finite and cutoff-sensitive.
P88 finite endpoint injectivity does not provide a positive ordinary infinite source or exclude one.
Nontrivial cycles remain separate from H72.
